Use the source as the construction reference. Preserve its existing contrasting trim assignment and all hardware; finish the main fabric in the requested target colour.

Branding: preserve the source graphic shapes, placement and exact text "MiloShopHand" only where visible on the source back. One intact chest ML only where that chest is visible. Output EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal square cells, native 1536x1024. Full garment with margins in each cell, no cropping. Row-major nominal views: 0,15,30,45,60,75 degrees, FRONT towards LEFT-facing profile; front points LEFT.
No labels, captions, borders, grid lines, people, hanger or mannequin. Commercial product photography, maintain this specific garment's identity.
